```{r}
#Packages
library(brms) #version 2.23.0, Bayesian GLMM fitting
library(dplyr) #version 1.1.4, for data manipulation
library(tidyr) #version 1.3.1, for data reshaping
library(tibble) #version 3.3.0, for data frame handling
library(bayesplot) #version 1.14.0, MCMC and PP check plots
library(tidybayes) #version 3.0.7, Posterior draws extraction
library(ggplot2) #version 3.5.2, visualizations
library(loo) #version 2.8.0, model comparisons
library(emmeans) #version 1.11.2-8, for posterior contrasts among tissues and CpGs
library(rmcorr) #version 0.7.0, for within individual correlations of tissue DNA methylation

options(brms.backend = "cmdstanr") #cmdstanr version 0.8.0, Stan backend for brms package
```

```{r}
df_tissue <- read.csv("../data/Lauer_etal_DNAm_euthanasia_data.csv")
```

```{r}
df_tissue <- df_tissue |>
  mutate(
    BirdID    = factor(BirdID),
    Stage     = factor(Stage),   
    EP        = factor(EP),         
    Tissue    = factor(Tissue),     
    SiteEuth = factor(SiteEuth), 
    DNAm      = as.integer(DNAm),   
    BodyMassz = as.numeric(scale(BodyMass)) #mean = 0, SD = 1
  ) 
 
```

```{r}
df_tissue_centered <- df_tissue %>%
  mutate(
    Tissue    = relevel(Tissue, ref = "blood"),
    EP        = relevel(EP,     ref = "high"),
    SiteEuth = relevel(SiteEuth, ref = "CG01")
  )
```

#Model Comparisons with Leave-One-Out Cross Validation in `loo`
```{r}
#Candidate model definition:
#DNAm binary behavior at each CpG site in each tissue
#SiteEuth: categorical identifier of CpG site - CpG 1 is the same here as in Kilvitis et al. 2019
#EP: categorical high or low determined in Sheldon et al. 2023
#Stage: juvenile, male, or female - Sheldon et al., 2023
#BodyMassz: z-score centered body mass in grams taken at capture in Sheldon et al. 2023

#Model i:
form_dnam_term <- bf(
  DNAm ~ Tissue * SiteEuth + Tissue*EP + Stage + BodyMassz +
    (1 | BirdID),
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit")
)

#Model ii:
form_dnam_tissue_no_stage <- bf(
  DNAm ~ Tissue * SiteEuth + Tissue * EP + BodyMassz + (1 | BirdID),
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit")
)

#Model iii:
form_dnam_tissue_no_bodymass <- bf(
  DNAm ~ Tissue * SiteEuth + Tissue * EP + Stage + (1 | BirdID),
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit")
)

#Model iv:
form_dnam_tissue_no_epinteraction <- bf(
  DNAm ~ Tissue * SiteEuth + EP + Stage + BodyMassz + (1 | BirdID),
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit")
)

#Model v:
form_dnam_tissue_minimal <- bf(
  DNAm ~ Tissue * SiteEuth + (1 | BirdID),
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit")
)


```

```{r}
#Subsetting data for model comparisons
df_tissue_cc <- df_tissue_centered %>%
  filter(complete.cases(DNAm, Tissue, SiteEuth, EP, Stage, BodyMassz))
```


```{r}
#Prior specification for all models
priors_dnam_tissue <- c(
  set_prior("normal(0, 1)", class = "b"),                
  set_prior("student_t(3, 0, 2.5)", class = "Intercept"),
  set_prior("student_t(3, 0, 1)", class = "sd")          
)
```

```{r}
#Candidate model fitting:

#Model i:
fit_dnam_term <- brm(
  formula = form_dnam_term,
  data    = df_tissue_cc,
  family  = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  prior   = priors_dnam_tissue,
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 4000,
  warmup  = 2000,
  cores   = 4,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  seed    = 717
)

#Model 2:
fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage <- brm(
  formula = form_dnam_tissue_no_stage,
  data    = df_tissue_cc,
  family  = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  prior   = priors_dnam_tissue,
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 4000,
  warmup  = 2000,
  cores   = 4,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  seed    = 717
)

#Model iii:
fit_dnam_tissue_no_bodymass <- brm(
  formula = form_dnam_tissue_no_bodymass,
  data    = df_tissue_cc,
  family  = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  prior   = priors_dnam_tissue,
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 4000,
  warmup  = 2000,
  cores   = 4,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  seed    = 717
)

#Model iv:
fit_dnam_tissue_no_epX <- brm(
  formula = form_dnam_tissue_no_epinteraction,
  data    = df_tissue_cc,
  family  = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  prior   = priors_dnam_tissue,
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 4000,
  warmup  = 2000,
  cores   = 4,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  seed    = 717
)

#Model v:
fit_dnam_tissue_minimal <- brm(
  formula = form_dnam_tissue_minimal,
  data    = df_tissue_cc,
  family  = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  prior   = priors_dnam_tissue,
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 4000,
  warmup  = 2000,
  cores   = 4,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  seed    = 717
)
```

```{r}
#LOO model comparison:
fit_dnam_term <- add_criterion(fit_dnam_term, "loo")
fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage <- add_criterion(fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage, "loo")
fit_dnam_tissue_no_bodymass <- add_criterion(fit_dnam_tissue_no_bodymass, "loo")
fit_dnam_tissue_no_epX <- add_criterion(fit_dnam_tissue_no_epX, "loo")
fit_dnam_tissue_minimal <- add_criterion(fit_dnam_tissue_minimal, "loo")

loo_compare(fit_dnam_term, fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage, fit_dnam_tissue_no_bodymass, fit_dnam_tissue_no_epX, fit_dnam_tissue_minimal)

print(fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage$criteria$loo)
print(fit_dnam_tissue_no_bodymass$criteria$loo)
print(fit_dnam_term$criteria$loo)
print(fit_dnam_tissue_no_epX$criteria$loo)
print(fit_dnam_tissue_minimal$criteria$loo)

loo_list <- list(
  fit_dnam_term                = fit_dnam_term$criteria$loo,
  fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage     = fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage$criteria$loo,
  fit_dnam_tissue_no_bodymass  = fit_dnam_tissue_no_bodymass$criteria$loo,
  fit_dnam_tissue_no_epX       = fit_dnam_tissue_no_epX$criteria$loo,
  fit_dnam_tissue_minimal      = fit_dnam_tissue_minimal$criteria$loo
)

loo_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(loo_list, function(x) {
  e <- x$estimates
  tibble::tibble(
    elpd_loo    = e["elpd_loo","Estimate"], se_elpd_loo = e["elpd_loo","SE"],
    p_loo       = e["p_loo","Estimate"],    se_p_loo    = e["p_loo","SE"],
    looic       = e["looic","Estimate"],    se_looic    = e["looic","SE"]
  )
}, .id = "Model")

comp <- loo_compare(fit_dnam_term, fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage, fit_dnam_tissue_no_bodymass,
                     fit_dnam_tissue_no_epX, fit_dnam_tissue_minimal)
comp_df <- as.data.frame(comp) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Model") %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, elpd_diff, se_diff)

loo_table <- dplyr::left_join(loo_summary, comp_df, by = "Model")

loo_table <- loo_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Model = dplyr::recode(Model,
    fit_dnam_term                = "Full",
    fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage     = "No Stage",
    fit_dnam_tissue_no_bodymass  = "No BodyMassz",
    fit_dnam_tissue_no_epX       = "No Tissue:EP",
    fit_dnam_tissue_minimal      = "Minimal (core only)"
  ))

loo_table
```

#Model Fitting
```{r}
fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage_final <- brm(
  formula = form_dnam_tissue_no_stage,
  data    = df_tissue_centered,
  family  = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  prior   = priors_dnam_tissue,
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 4000,
  warmup  = 2000,
  cores   = 4,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  seed    = 717
)
```

```{r}
summary(fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage_final)
conditional_effects(fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage_final)

mcmc_plot(fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage_final, type = "trace")

pp_check(fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage_final, type = "bars")
pp_check(fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage_final, type = "stat", stat = "mean")
pp_check(fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage_final, type = "stat_grouped", group = "SiteEuth")
pp_check(fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage_final, type = "stat_grouped", group = "Tissue")

```

```{r}
# Ensure factor order matches
df_tissue_centered <- df_tissue_centered %>%
  mutate(
    Tissue  = factor(Tissue, levels = c("blood","liver","spleen")),
    SiteEuth = factor(SiteEuth, levels = c("CG01","CG02","CG03","CG04","CG05"))
  )

# This portion is used to generate Figure 3 in manuscript
newdat <- expand.grid(
  Tissue   = levels(df_tissue_centered$Tissue),
  SiteEuth = levels(df_tissue_centered$SiteEuth),
  EP       = "high",
  BodyMassz = 0
)

pred <- fitted(
  fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage_final,
  newdata = newdat,
  re_formula = NA,
  scale = "response",
  summary = TRUE
) %>% as.data.frame()

plot_df <- bind_cols(newdat, pred) %>%
  rename(p = Estimate, lo = Q2.5, hi = Q97.5)

plot_df$SiteEuth <- factor(
  plot_df$SiteEuth,
  levels = c("CG01","CG02","CG03","CG04","CG05"),
  labels = c("CpG 1","CpG 2","CpG 3","CpG 4","CpG 5")
)
```

```{r}
#Generation of Figure 3 in manuscript
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = SiteEuth, y = p, shape = SiteEuth)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                width = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ Tissue, nrow = 1) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "CpG 1" = 16,  
      "CpG 2" = 17,  
      "CpG 3" = 15,  
      "CpG 4" = 3,   
      "CpG 5" = 4    
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 11),
    strip.text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 12),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "CpG site",
    y = "DNA methylation probability (p̂)"
  )
```

#Repeated measures correlations among tissues with `rmcorr`
```{r}
df_tissue_wide <- df_tissue_centered %>%
  select(BirdID, Tissue, SiteEuth, DNAm) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols    = c(BirdID, SiteEuth),
    names_from = Tissue,
    values_from = DNAm
  )

rmcorr_blood_liver  <- rmcorr(participant = BirdID, measure1 = blood,  measure2 = liver,  dataset = df_tissue_wide)
rmcorr_blood_spleen <- rmcorr(participant = BirdID, measure1 = blood,  measure2 = spleen, dataset = df_tissue_wide)
rmcorr_liver_spleen <- rmcorr(participant = BirdID, measure1 = liver,  measure2 = spleen, dataset = df_tissue_wide)
```

```{r}
rmcorr_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  Tissue_pair = c("Blood-Liver", "Blood-Spleen", "Liver-Spleen"),
  r        = c(rmcorr_blood_liver$r,  rmcorr_blood_spleen$r,  rmcorr_liver_spleen$r),
  df       = c(rmcorr_blood_liver$df, rmcorr_blood_spleen$df, rmcorr_liver_spleen$df),
  p        = c(rmcorr_blood_liver$p,  rmcorr_blood_spleen$p,  rmcorr_liver_spleen$p),
  CI_lower = c(rmcorr_blood_liver$CI[1], rmcorr_blood_spleen$CI[1], rmcorr_liver_spleen$CI[1]),
  CI_upper = c(rmcorr_blood_liver$CI[2], rmcorr_blood_spleen$CI[2], rmcorr_liver_spleen$CI[2])
)

rmcorr_summary
```


#`Emmeans` comparisons of CpG sites between tissues
```{r}
emm <- emmeans(
  fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage_final,
  ~ Tissue | SiteEuth,
  re_formula = NA   # population-level effects
)

emm
#Displays estimated log-odds of DNAm in that CpG site in that tissue, averaged over covariates, as emmean

#Posterior probabilities from emmeans
pairs(emm, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))

```

```{r}
#Probabilities contrasts instead of log-odds
emmeans(
  fit_dnam_tissue_no_stage_final,
  ~ Tissue | SiteEuth,
  type = "response",
  re_formula = NA
)
```
